europe_now.title: French Unrest and Security Measures
europe_now.summary: France announced localized curfews and increased pressure on online resellers following a weekend of widespread looting and violent protests. Prime Minister Lecornu indicated readiness to declare a state of emergency if necessary as civil unrest continued to impact the country.

sources.headline: France: ‘localised’ curfews announced after weekend of violence

europe_now.title: Space Security Tensions
europe_now.summary: Reports emerged that a Russian KOSMOS military satellite was tracking a Finnish spy satellite in orbit. Analysts noted the incident could represent a precursor to heightened security conflicts in space.

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Protests in Europe
top_stories.summary: France faced intense civil unrest and looting over the weekend, prompting government leaders to consider states of emergency and localized curfews. Meanwhile, southern Italy experienced blocked roads and empty shelves due to similar cost-of-living demonstrations.

top_stories.title: Regional Defense and Space Security
top_stories.summary: A Russian military satellite was observed stalking a Finnish spy satellite in low Earth orbit. Separately, Ukraine deployed a drone to execute a medical evacuation of a wounded soldier in an unprecedented operation.
